news.title: Investor sentiment improves as stock rises 15%
news.body: After last week's 15% share price gain to ₹24.28, the stock trades at a trailing P/E ratio of 4.6x. Average trailing P/E is 17x in the Luxury industry in India. Total loss to shareholders of 19% over the past year.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.4% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Interest payments are not well covered by earnings (2.2x net interest cover). Revenue has declined by 27% over the past year. Market cap is less than US$10m (₹227.7m market cap, or US$2.49m).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.71 loss per share (vs ₹1.01 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹0.71 loss per share (improved from ₹1.01 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹322.2m (down 18% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹7.57m (loss narrowed 29% from 3Q 2025).

news.title: New major risk - Financial position
news.body: The company's interest payments are not well covered by earnings. Net interest cover: 0.05x This is considered a major risk. If the company is unable to fund interest repayments on its debt through profits, it may be forced into reducing its debt burden through selling assets, undertaking a potentially costly capital raising or even into bankruptcy in the worst case scenario.
